tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: What MVR 19 is: the building, the seven residences, prices, the Golden Visa route and its conditions, reservations, status and the developer (the site's llms.txt summary, in English).

tools.name: list_residences
tools.description: The seven residences with floor, area, bedrooms, bathrooms, storage room, outdoor space, price and live status ("Reservations open", "Reserved" or "Sold"). Optional filters.

tools.name: get_residence
tools.description: Everything about one residence (GF1, GF2, A1, A2, B1, B2 or the penthouse C1): its data, room areas, status and the full text of its page.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Every page of mav19-goldenvisa.com in one language, with its path, title and description: the residences, the Golden Visa explainer, timeline, Patras, location, gallery, developer, FAQ, guides and legal pages.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one page as Markdown, by its path from list_pages (e.g. "/faq", "/guides/golden-visa-costs-taxes", "/el/residences/b2").

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Full-text search of the pages in one language; returns the best matches with a snippet and path for get_page.
